purpose: Teach: 知識人/会派/替わり/積ま/計っ/常用/手作業/シード

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今度の講演会、知識人を多数招くな。
lines.en: For the upcoming lecture, we'll need to invite a number of prominent intellectuals.
lines.style: Measured directive. Even pace, no rush. Opens with calm authority. Sits at desk level—hands steady, eyes clear. Not unkind, but brooking no questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、保守派と改革派の会派、調整中です。
lines.en: Understood. We're currently coordinating between the conservative and reform factions within the company.
lines.style: Professional, itemizing. Respectful cadence—each fact placed precisely. Slight lean forward to show engagement. Alert and earnest, not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 部長の替わりに、君に、出席してもらう。
lines.en: I want you to attend in the department head's place.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Gentle but direct—like assigning trust. No performative delivery. Slight pause before the assignment lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫、商品、これ以上、積まないでください。
lines.en: Understood. Also, we should stop stacking more inventory in the warehouse.
lines.style: Practical pivot—topic shift without ceremony. Even tone, straightforward. The voice of someone managing multiple details without strain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績、しっかり計った上で、判断する。
lines.en: We'll evaluate performance once we've measured results carefully.
lines.style: Principle stated simply. Measured, reflective pace. A reminder of standards rather than a rebuke. Settles slightly back in chair.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社用車、常用しているのは、私だけです。
lines.en: Understood. I'm the only one using the company vehicle on a regular basis.
lines.style: Factual update. Level tone, no apology or over-explanation. Direct, as though checking off a list together. Quick and clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 検品は、手作業で、慎重にやれ。
lines.en: Make sure quality control is done by hand and with full attention.
lines.style: Instruction with weight. Slower on the key word—「手作業」—slight emphasis. Not harsh, but the implication is clear: this matters, take care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業に、シードマネー、確保しています。
lines.en: Understood. We've already secured seed funding for the new venture.
lines.style: Closing note of competence. Slightly lighter cadence—good news delivered without fanfare. Confident, concise, ready to wrap.
